conclusions.text: The unchanged original 106333-cell, 556-owner, 36063-interval Japan repair package is source-relatively qualified by the genuine stock constructor with zero held cells; whole source and negative competitors, original target intent and exact denominator remain preserved.

Contemporary legal boundaries and dry land, whole-candidate geography, full MLIT/GSI applicability, #1633 report-validator behavior, final selected/current-owner-zero/emitted acceptance and delivery remain unresolved or pending.

limits: No selector, cumulative ledger, accepted ownership, emitted raster, regional certificate or deployment is changed by this source-authority handoff.

Complete originals total 1789 features and 8659098 decoded bytes. ADM2 advertises 1745 but contains 1742; its Subprefectures label is not the selected municipality/city-ward intent. 2017 is a represented-year claim, distinct from January 19 2023 update and December 12 2023 build.

Tokyo is the recorded 53-member source-city aggregate with 431 requested cells, not modern prefectural jurisdiction. Fudai has a null original source name; recorded code 03485 and the MLIT/Geolonia name crosswalk explain the target label but do not authorize different geometry.

The original full corpus census has 368 products, 73567 features and 7089 foreign ownerless features absent from these exact requested-centre memberships. This is census-relative; it is not a worldwide territorial claim.

The complete 258-feature Natural Earth country check has 48457 Japan-centre hits, zero foreign hits and 57876 uncovered/unknown centres. Invalid Egypt is retained unchanged with all candidate centres outside its complete bounds.
All whole physical reconstruction, contradictory-support and container discrepancies remain; native-cell support does not establish whole-feature correctness or current dry land.

Nine cells overlap three original historical candidates. Full/simplified memberships agree at those nine only; original whole-candidate limitations remain. Raw 28 routing, 28 physical, 9 family and 3 source-summary references are independently checked without claiming #1633 fixed.

The separate 21791-cell/540-owner physical-interpretation companion is excluded from repair credit. MLIT native N03 2017 archive (242211059 bytes) was not restored or replayed; GSI finite high-resolution applicability remains unavailable.

Tests: 180/181 passed initially; one missing retained latitude fixture was restored from exact immutable Git bytes, then all four tests in its affected suite passed. No full application or hosted emitted-consumer test is claimed.
